observation.command: cd /workspace && find app -maxdepth 2 -name ".npmrc" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== root .npmrc ==="; ls -la .npmrc 2>/dev/null; cat .npmrc 2>/dev/null; echo "=== search for npm.pkg.github / npm registry auth in scripts ==="; grep -rn "npm.pkg.github\|NPM_TOKEN\|registry" scripts/ app/.npmrc 2>/dev/null | head
